data.body: [P1] This is not a lossless release queue. GitHub concurrency groups retain at most one running and one pending run; a subsequent release cancels the older pending run even with `cancel-in-progress: false`. Because this group covers the entire workflow, even an SDK/OTel no-op release can cancel a queued testing release before its image is published. Key per-version publication by release tag, then serialize only a global `latest` reconciler that derives the maximum registry version, or use a lock/queue that preserves every waiter.
